situation_block.label: Your situation
situation_block.body: Recovering from major abdominal surgery while solely carrying newborn care - lifting rules, pain schedule, incision checks, feeding round the clock - alone. She does not know what is safe to do, how to manage pain and movement solo, what normal healing looks like versus infection, and collapses under the load by day 4.
